page.overview:
Who is Spikey Fillups?

Spikey Fillups is a next-generation Piston Cup racer. He has a sea-styled paint job. Spikey enters the Piston Cup in the beginning of the 2017 season, replacing Ralph Carlow as the Lil' Torquey Pistons racer.
